extracted.name: Cheese Bread (Harper Compact All-Temp Oven Cooking Guide)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Cheese Bread (Harper Compact All-Temp Oven Cooking Guide).
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups grated sharp natural cheddar cheese
6 Tablespoons white distilled vinegar plus milk to make 1 1/2 cups
instruction_lines: Sift flour, soda, and salt into mixing bowl. Add grated cheese; mix well.
Beat eggs and add them to the liquid and shortening and blend well. Stir in caraway seeds.
Add all at once to flour mixture and mix lightly.
Turn into greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan and bake in 350°F oven 1 hour 10 minutes or until done.
Remove from pan and cool several hours or overnight before slicing.
